name: sharp-compact
description: Every compaction keeps what matters: the session writes its own handoff brief first.

timeoutSeconds.title: Brief timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the session's brief before compacting normally.

briefPrompt.title: Brief prompt
briefPrompt.description: Replaces the default prompt that asks the session for its handoff brief. Empty uses the default.

idleMinutes.title: Idle reminder (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: After this many idle minutes, warn that the prompt cache is about to expire (1h on subscriptions, use 4 for the 5-minute API cache). 0 turns it off.

idleCompact.title: Compact when idle
idleCompact.description: Compact automatically instead of only warning when the idle time is reached.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact ahead at (% of context)
compactAtPercent.description: After a turn, compact with a brief once the context is this full, ahead of Claude Code's own auto-compact. Use it on Team and Enterprise accounts, where auto-compact runs without a brief. 0 turns it off.
